channel.title: The Grant Desk - next 90 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: next 90 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council: Media Artists Creation Projects (October 2026 deadline)
item.description: Ontario Arts Council · deadline 08 Oct 2026 · Emerging: maximum CAD 10,000; Mid-Career and Established: maximum CAD 40,000. No application fee.

item.title: NetHope: Humanitarian AI Research Fellowship 2026 (Remote)
item.description: NetHope · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Stipend; the amount is not published in the call (details are shared with selected fellows and set out in the fellowship agreement). Part-time, approximately 10 hours per week. 4 to 6 fellows selected. No application fee.

item.title: Manitoba Arts Council: Create Grant (October 2026 intake)
item.description: Manitoba Arts Council · deadline 10 Oct 2026 · Emerging: up to CAD 7,500; Mid-career: up to CAD 10,000; Established: up to CAD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY Virtual Residency, Fall 2026 (US-based artists)
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline 11 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend for each of six selected artists, plus weekly residency programming, mentorship with Eyebeam alumni and visiting professionals, technical consultation, and access to tools and expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: Rhizome x Hartwig Art Foundation: Amsterdam City Fellow (two-year digital art research fellowship)
item.description: Rhizome, in partnership with Hartwig Art Foundation · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 per month stipend for a part-time commitment of roughly 2 days per week, over a two-year term (about EUR 28,800 total). Tickets to the Extreme Presence gathering provided. No application fee indicated.

item.title: CNC: Fonds d'aide a la creation immersive (October 2026 session)
item.description: CNC (Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · Selective aid in four strands: ecriture, preproduction, production and portage. The call page publishes percentage caps (up to 50% of French financing, 80% by derogation); CNC's own published commission results show ecriture grants of EUR 10,000 to 12,000, preproduction up to EUR 60,000 and production up to EUR 80,000. No application fee.

Research Grant: a free private bedroom at the Pedantic Apartment plus a USD 500 or USD 1,000 honorarium at the grantee's discretion. Application free until 28 September 2026, then USD 20.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Teatri Riflessi 2027: Short Performance Competition (12th edition)
    https://www.iterculture.eu/en/teatri-riflessi/tr2027/tr12/
    IterCulture APS · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Gross performance fee of EUR 500 to EUR 1,100 (VAT included) per selected short performance, scaled by the number of performers on stage, plus a possible travel contribution of up to EUR 250 subject to available funding, place of origin, cast size and absence of external touring grants. At least 10 performances are selected. Competition prizes: Best Performance EUR 1,200; Best Dramaturgy, Best Direction, Best Performer and the Scholars' and Critics' Award EUR 500 each; 'Valentina Nicosia' Fund EUR 500; 'Sandra Bressan' research fund EUR 1,800; Youth Jury Award EUR 300; plus non-cash awards (Audience Special Mention, Companies' Choice, Technical Crew). Panel members and Teatri Riflessi Network partners may also award special prizes in the form of artist residencies and touring opportunities. Application is free; selected companies pay a EUR 50 deposit that is fully refunded after the festival.
  • Design Trust Seed, Feature & Impact Grants (Hong Kong / Greater Bay Area)
    https://designtrust.hk/grants/dtgrants/
    Design Trust · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · Seed Grant: HKD 50,000. Feature Grant: capped at HKD 300,000, awarded annually upon special consideration. Impact Grant: case-by-case, for former grantees. Full or partial funding on a case-by-case basis. Free to apply.
  • ACLS Digital Justice Grants 2026-27 (Seed and Development)
    https://www.acls.org/programs/acls-digital-justice-grants/
    American Council of Learned Societies (ACLS), funded by the Mellon Foundation · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · Seed Grants USD 10,000 to 25,000 for start-up and prototyping work; Development Grants USD 50,000 to 100,000 for projects past proof of concept. Institutional indirect costs are not covered. No application fee.
  • EMAP / EMARE: European Media Art Platform Residencies 2027
    https://call.emare.eu/
    European Media Art Platform (EMAP / EMARE) · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 4,000 grant for the applying artist (including subsistence); EUR 2,000 for a collaborating artist (EUR 6,000 total for a duo); EUR 4,000 project budget; accommodation provided by the host; travel covered per EU ceilings; access to technical facilities and media labs. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:

    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.

    https://theleonlevycenterforbiography.submittable.com/submit
